text:
chris: Heads up — coordinating dinner for the CTOS summit on Tues night (arriving ppl 6:30–8pm). Looking for SOMA/South Beach recs. Group of ~12, wheelchair accessible, must handle a nut allergy, a couple pescatarians and one vegan. Prefer a reservable side room or patio. Budget around $75/person. Any favorites?
olivia: Pier House on 3rd has a private side room and good veg options. Not cheap but they do a set menu which might keep costs predictable. OpenTable link: https://opentable.example/pierhouse (ask for "side room").
sam: +1 Pier House for formality. If you want something more casual and cheaper, Lowlight BBQ can do family-style set menus and they'll label allergens.
maya: If the group wants a low-key vibe, Tabla Taco (off Folsom) will do taco packages and can reserve the back patio. But need to check wheelchair access.
kevin: Noted on allergies — is the nut-allergy severe? also any gluten-free folks?
chris: Nut allergy is anaphylactic (one person). Two pescatarians, one fully vegan, one in a wheelchair.
olivia: I can call Pier House tonight to confirm accessibility and vegan/GF options. They told me once they had a ramp and accessible restroom but I will reconfirm.
alex: Another wildcard: Modern Kebab on Folsom can handle 12 with a fixed menu and are very flexible on dietary needs. Cheaper, so more margin.
sam: Quick poll for vibe: react with :taco: for Casual tacos/patio, :fish: for Sit-down seafood (Pier House), :meat_on_bone: for Family-style comfort (BBQ/Kebab).
lunchbot: Poll: react in-thread. (Poll auto-closes in 6h)
maya: :taco: but concerned about wheelchair access at Tabla.
olivia: Pier House just called back — side room available Tue 7pm, can do set menu at $68/person + tax, will accommodate vegan + GF + note nuts and can block the door for ramp access. Need a CC to hold.
chris: That sounds perfect. If Pier House can hold for 24h I'll collect cards. Who's definitively in so I can send the deposit? @maya @sam @alex @kevin
sam: In.
maya: In — I'll bring my allergy card and message the waiter.
alex: In.
kevin: In. Thanks olivia for confirming. :thumbsup:
chris: I'll drop a calendar invite with address + menu and add the reservation confirmation. If anyone has objections speak up here, otherwise I'll finalize the booking tonight.
olivia: FYI Pier House asked for any dietary notes in advance — send me names and restrictions and I'll add them to the reservation.
chris: Will DM the list. Thanks everyone!
